tasks.short: Write proposals for external research funding

steps.what: Define grant proposal claims and capture research plans, evidence, budget and call requirements
Write grant proposals using the checked research brief and funding-call structure

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose for the researcher's chosen project.
loop.input: Checked brief with actual methods, evidence, budget, call criteria and source references.
loop.output: Proposal draft with traceable claims and explicit gaps.
loop.check: Teacher checks every scientific claim, citation, method, budget explanation and promised result against the brief and call; plausible prose is not evidence.
loop.stop: At most two redrafts; unsupported claims, confidential-input restrictions or missing evidence return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide headings but cannot express varied research rationale and method limitations faithfully.

steps.what: Verify the complete proposal and approve its version for the existing submission process

tasks.design: Use a native call template in {DOCS} and a bounded loop to draft from the teacher's checked research brief. The teacher retains scientific choices, verifies every claim and approves the exact proposal for the existing institutional submission process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning an actual research plan into clear funder-specific prose requires substantial writing.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting step can express supplied plans and evidence without inventing the research.
tasks.still_hard: Make a credible scientific case and commit only to feasible methods, resources and outcomes.
tasks.human_edge: Know what the research can support and defend its significance honestly.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose work; research and submission authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Connect methods, evidence, risks and budget to call criteria.

evidence.claim: Bounded proposal drafting can assist prose preparation from supplied evidence; this design and saving are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is proposal preparation and internal handoff, excluding original research, institutional approvals and external portal submission. Existing research-support work is unchanged.

The funder publishes the call before s1; the teacher supplies research choices and source evidence, while existing finance and collaborators supply budget inputs. The teacher captures call version, criteria, methods, source identifiers, actual achievements, budget amounts, risks and commitments during retained s1 time.

No free structured proposal brief is assumed. Missing or confidential evidence requires manual handling and is not inferred by the model; tool access and funder conditions must be confirmed before use.
Test native templates first. Draft checking in s2 and final whole-proposal verification in s3 are separate counted work. Additional focal upkeep is 6 hours per 100 baseline hours.
unknowns: Funder conditions and institutional tool permission
Quality of available research and budget inputs
research_questions: Does a checked brief-based draft reduce total writing effort without introducing unsupported commitments?

already_counted.description: Scientific choices and source capture remain.
Draft claim verification remains within writing.
Complete proposal review and internal approval remain.

incremental.description: Maintain drafting guidance and investigate citation or source failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete proposal version, call version, cited sources, methods, budget and commitments approved for internal handoff in s3; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+40*0.65+25=86; gross=14, upkeep=6, central net=8. Conservative 0-4 allows extensive scientific rewriting and restricted inputs; research choices and final verification keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform department administrative duties by coordinating priorities and resolving operational decisions

tasks.design: Keep departmental coordination and leadership decisions with the teacher acting as department head. Existing requirements in {DOCS} support that work; no particular duplicate clerical step is assumed from this broad task statement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Department leadership requires resolving competing needs within institutional authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference access supports decisions but does not establish a repeatable clerical saving.
tasks.still_hard: Prioritise requests fairly and agree feasible responsibilities with staff.
tasks.human_edge: Handle sensitive disagreements and remain accountable for departmental choices.
tasks.altitude: Departmental responsibility and delegated authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clarify decision ownership and communicate reasons for priorities.

evidence.claim: A broad departmental administration task does not by itself establish a removable manual data-entry baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is direct departmental coordination and decisions, excluding separately described teaching, recruitment, grants and specific reporting workflows.

Institutional owners provide requirements before discussion; staff raise requests during s1. The department head gathers facts and clarifies responsibility in retained time; no structured priority or suitability flag is presumed.
Existing staff participation remains unchanged outside the focal denominator. Native document access suffices; no new system, recording or upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
unknowns: Actual administrative duties and current clerical duplication
research_questions: Which specific recurring administrative action, if any, is currently repeated across systems?

already_counted.description: All departmental coordination and decision work remains.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No specific removable clerical step is established and leadership time remains human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select specialized materials for outside reading and capture verified reference records
Compile bibliographies by formatting and ordering the selected reference records
Check bibliography accuracy, access and reading suitability before releasing the list

tasks.design: Use a native reference manager, the {OTHER} scholarly catalogue and reference-management category, to format selected records for {LMS}. The teacher still finds suitable readings, resolves every source and checks the exact list before release; no generated titles are accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Formatting and ordering references can repeat bibliographic data already verified during selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference exports can apply citation styles consistently without inventing citations.
tasks.still_hard: Choose readings appropriate to the course and confirm that students can access the actual material.
tasks.human_edge: Judge relevance, difficulty and the value of the reading sequence.
tasks.altitude: Less manual citation formatting; reading selection stays with the teacher.

reach.learn: Resolve identifiers and check accessible editions.

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational papers, supporting literature discovery rather than proving the proposed citation-formatting saving.
Native formatting of verified references can remove repeated citation entry; the saving is an unmeasured model-knowledge scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is selection, bibliography compilation and reading-list release, excluding original research and separate course-content creation.

OTHER is scholarly catalogue and reference-management software. Publishers and catalogues supply existing reference metadata; the teacher selects and verifies title, authors, year, edition, publication, identifier, access location and reading order in retained s1 time.

s2 uses only the selected verified records from s1 and a teacher-selected citation style. Missing or conflicting metadata requires manual correction; no free structured reference record or generated source is assumed.

s3 resolves the actual items and checks suitability and access before release. Test native reference export first; already automated formatting earns no saving. Additional focal upkeep is 7 hours per 100 baseline hours.
unknowns: Catalogue export quality and student access
research_questions: Can native reference exports remove manual formatting while preserving correct editions and accessible links?

already_counted.description: Selection, reference capture and final accuracy and access checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain citation styles and resolve import metadata errors.

approvals.approved_version: Exact bibliography version, reference records, editions, order and access locations checked before release in s3; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+0+20=75; gross=25, upkeep=7, central net=18. Conservative 3-10 allows poor metadata and manual edition checking; reading selection and final checking keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Clarify the professional consulting problem, scope and relevant client constraints
Provide professional consulting advice and explain uncertainties and practical implications

tasks.design: Keep professional scoping and advice with the teacher, referring to authorised existing materials in {DOCS}. No generic consulting-report baseline or autonomous recommendation is assumed from the broad service description.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful advice depends on understanding the client's actual technical and organisational problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing knowledge access supports consulting without replacing professional responsibility.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise missing evidence, conflicts and limitations in advice for a specific client.
tasks.human_edge: Exercise expertise and explain what can and cannot be concluded.
tasks.altitude: Consulting scope and accountability remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clarify scope and communicate assumptions before recommending action.

evidence.claim: Contextual professional consulting is not established as a removable writing or entry task by the general service statement.

assumptions: Boundary is direct professional consulting, excluding separately contracted research, deliverable production and client implementation.

The client supplies the request and context before or during s1. The teacher checks relevant existing knowledge and clarifies gaps during retained human work before advising in s2; no free structured recommendation or suitability flag is assumed.
Existing client participation remains unchanged outside the focal denominator. Native document access suffices; no new tool, capture duty or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Which client facts must be clarified before advice becomes actionable?

already_counted.description: Scoping, knowledge checks and advice remain fully counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No professional consulting interaction or judgement is reduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher retains research, reading and professional decisions; checked drafting and reference formatting may reduce limited preparation work.
reach: Work with librarians on reliable reading-list records.
Explain research plans clearly to colleagues and research support staff.
role.ambitious_version: Use released formatting or drafting time to improve evidence quality while retaining human academic and professional judgement.
